cases.expected: URITranslator that performs identity translation (input URI equals output URI)
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory using the default builder (no custom uriMap or uriTranslators). Call getUriTranslator() and verify that the returned translator returns the same URI that is passed to its translate(URI) method, because the default uriMap is empty.

cases.expected: URITranslator that maps http://example.com/schema to classpath:/schemas/example-schema.json
cases.description: Build a JsonSchemaFactory with a custom uriMap containing a single mapping. After calling getUriTranslator(), invoke translate(sourceUri) and assert that the result equals targetUri. This covers the branch where uriMap is non‑empty.

cases.expected: URITranslator that maps http://b.com to classpath:/b.json
cases.description: Create a factory with a uriMap that has several entries. Verify that the translator correctly selects the mapping for the requested key, ensuring the map lookup logic works for more than one entry.

cases.expected: URITranslator that returns the original URI (identity) because the map is empty
cases.description: Build a factory with an explicitly empty uriMap (Collections.emptyMap()). The translator should behave as an identity translator when no mapping exists.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked
cases.description: Using reflection (or a custom Builder stub) set the private field uriMap to null. Calling getUriTranslator() should throw NPE because URITranslator.map(null) is not allowed. This tests the defensive‑programming branch where uriMap is unexpectedly null.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked
cases.description: Manipulate the private field uriTranslators to be null (e.g., via reflection). The method attempts to call with() on a null reference, resulting in NPE. This verifies behavior when the composite translator is not initialized.

cases.expected: Identity translation (output URI equals input URI) because the map key includes a trailing slash that does not match the supplied URI.
cases.description: Build a JsonSchemaFactory with a uriMap entry whose key ends with a '/'. Verify that a URI without the trailing slash is **not** matched and the translator behaves as an identity translator for that input.

cases.expected: classpath:/schema-slash.json
cases.description: Same factory as above, but the supplied URI includes the trailing slash, so the mapping should be applied and the translator should return the target URI.

cases.expected: Identity translation (output URI equals input URI) because map lookup is case‑sensitive.
cases.description: Create a factory with a mapping that uses upper‑case scheme and host. Pass a lower‑case URI and verify that the translator does **not** perform a case‑insensitive match.

cases.expected: classpath:/caps-schema.json
cases.description: When the exact case used in the map key is supplied, the translation succeeds, confirming that the matching is case‑sensitive rather than case‑insensitive.

cases.expected: classpath:/schema-section.json
cases.description: Mapping that includes a fragment identifier. The translator must match the full URI (including fragment) and return the associated target.

cases.expected: classpath:/schema-v1.json
cases.description: Mapping that includes a query string. The translator must treat the query part as part of the key.

cases.expected: Identity translation (output URI equals input URI) because the supplied URI lacks both fragment and query and therefore does not match any map entry.
cases.description: Ensures that a URI that matches the base part of a mapped key but differs in fragment/query does **not** get incorrectly translated.

cases.expected: classpath:/override-from-composite.json
cases.description: Build a factory where the underlying CompositeURITranslator already contains a mapping for the same source URI. After calling getUriTranslator(), the method adds the map‑based translator *after* the existing composite via `with()`. The test verifies that the original composite mapping takes precedence, i.e., the result comes from the pre‑existing translator, not the newly added map entry.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked (or when translate is called) because the map contains a null key.
cases.description: Inject a map with a null key (using reflection or a custom builder). The `URITranslator.map` implementation is expected to reject null keys, resulting in an NPE.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown when translate() is invoked because the map contains a null target value.
cases.description: Create a factory with a mapping whose value is null. When the translator attempts to return the mapped value, it should raise an NPE, confirming defensive checks for null values.

cases.expected: Instance of com.networknt.schema.uri.URITranslator (not null)
cases.description: Regardless of the internal state (default factory, empty map, etc.), calling getUriTranslator() must never return null and must return an object that implements the URITranslator interface.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or URISyntaxException) thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked because the map contains a key that is not a valid URI
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory with a uriMap whose key is syntactically invalid as a URI. Calling getUriTranslator() should fail during the creation of the map‑based translator, verifying that malformed source URIs are rejected.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or URISyntaxException) thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked because the map contains a value that is not a valid URI
cases.description: Create a JsonSchemaFactory with a uriMap whose target value cannot be parsed as a URI. The translator construction should detect the invalid target and throw an exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked because the map contains an empty string as a key
cases.description: Inject a map with an empty string key. The URITranslator.map implementation should reject empty keys and raise an exception during translator creation.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown when getUriTranslator() is invoked because the map contains an empty string as a value
cases.description: Inject a map where the target URI is an empty string. The translator should treat this as invalid and throw an exception at construction time.
